ql: assigns arenaConfigFromCache; client/assets/player.js calls it with the result of CacheManager.buildArenaConfig

vN: inferred: returns { center, side1, side2 }, the three tiles in a line that getFireballImpactTiles lists
kN: inferred: the explosion tiles two or more tiles from the center; getFireballExplosionTiles joins them with the inner ones
SN: inferred: the explosion tiles on and next to the center; getFireballExplosionTiles joins them with the outer ones

PN: getYamaWaveRandomOffset returns one of its entries; config key waves.randomOffsets turns them on

cI: inferred: per monster kind the words { one, many, game } used in messages ("Could not read the ${...one} tiles in the link.")
SI: inferred: joins the count of each monster kind into a string that rendering.js compares to find the wave with the same monsters
bI: inferred: writes "2 magers, 1 ranger and 3 bats" for the messages "which has ..." and "No wave spawns exactly ..."
zI: inferred: kind to letter; formatInfernoSpawnLayout writes slots with it
wI: inferred: the kind-to-code table inverted; parseInfernoSpawnLayout reads slots with it
AI: inferred: the regular expression parseInfernoSpawnLayout matches a layout string against ("wave:nine slot letters")
